svg.desc: 11 public repositories arranged in a deterministic star field. Solid lines connect projects through selected languages; detected languages include secondary languages; dotted bridges join nearby groups visually and do not represent dependencies. 55 of 55 shared connections shown. Brighter paths emphasize nearby relationships; faint paths preserve the remaining selected overlaps.
